title: Installation Jobs Tariff Note: Late Reschedule Fee Amount
content:
**Tariff note — amount of the late reschedule fee on Installation Jobs**

The late reschedule fee billed on an **Installation Jobs** record for a customer reschedule is the late reschedule fee of the job's installation method, charged in full. The figure for each method is the late reschedule fee shown in the product's reschedule tariff by installation method.

The fee is stated in USD. Every multiplier on the late reschedule fee acts together on the one figure the reschedule is charged from, and that product is rounded to the nearest cent once, as the last step of its pricing. It is dated the day the reschedule being charged was requested.

## Elements of the charge

| Element | Basis |
|---|---|
| Amount | the method's late reschedule fee, in full |
| Rounding | to the nearest cent, as the last step |
| Date | the day the reschedule being charged was requested |
| Account | the job charges, collected with the contract's final balance |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A customer reschedule is requested on a Monday on a job whose method carries a hypothetical late reschedule fee figure of 160.00. The fee billed is 160.00, charged in full and dated that Monday, the day of the request.

## Points of the note

- **Which method.** The figure is the one for the installation method named on the job being charged.
- **Which date.** The request date of the reschedule being charged fixes the fee date, whatever day the fee is booked.
